hook_text: It is 2 p.m. in Joburg. Your aunt in Beijing is already eating supper. How?
clip_script: Ayanda calls the family! It is 14:00 in Johannesburg. Beijing is east, 6 hours ahead: 20:00, supper time. São Paulo is west, 5 hours behind: 09:00, breakfast! Uncle flies to Dubai: leaves 10:30, flies 8 hours. That is 18:30 our time. Dubai is 2 ahead: he lands at 20:30 local time. And 20:00 here? In Tokyo, it is already 03:00 tomorrow!
visual_style: A spinning globe with a day-night line sweeping across, and clocks over each city changing as the camera moves east and west.
mood: Global and curious, like a travel adventure.
pacing: Quick city hops, a slow flight arc, then a midnight surprise.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and work out the time in Tokyo right now.
